text:
Zara L: quick findings from a 5k warmup for atlas10b int6 vs int8 on our mixed-chat slice. headline: int6 cuts token cost ~29% but we see a small uptick in abstractive hallucinations concentrated on >1.8k token contexts. short thread.

Ben T: paste top-line numbers pls.

Zara L: eval-bot summary: n=5000, cost_delta=-29% (int6 vs int8), qa_delta=-1.1pp, halluc_delta=+1.9pp, p95_latency+9ms

Zara L: quick table (rounded):
```
variant        cost/1k  QA_acc  halluc_rate  p95
atlas10b-int8  $0.78    81.7%   2.7%         205ms
atlas10b-int6  $0.55    80.6%   4.6%         214ms
```

Miroslav: where are failures concentrated?

Zara L: mainly longform abstractive summaries and multi-turn clarifying threads; single-turn QA and code tasks stable (~0.2pp QA drop).

Ben T: mitigation ideas?

Zara L: tested: 1) length-based routing (if tokens>1800 -> int8) -> effective cost down ~21% with halluc close to baseline; 2) confidence-triggered quick-rescore (logits-only int8) -> recovers ~1.1pp halluc for +3% cost.

Product-GTN: want a one-paragraph blurb + unit econ for GTN.

Zara L: exec blurb: "Recommend piloting int6 as default for short, cost-sensitive endpoints while routing long contexts (>1.8k tokens) to int8. In simulation this hybrid yields ~21% model-spend savings versus all-int8 while keeping longform hallucination near baseline. Start 5% canary -> 25% over 2 weeks with gates on hallucination, QA-slice deltas, and p95 latency. Fallback to all-int8 if hallucination >5% for 5m."

Zara L: unit econ quick calc (assume avg tokens/req=1.4k): baseline all-int8 per_1M_req ~= $1,092; hybrid per_1M_req ~= $863; savings ~= $229 / 1M reqs (~21%).

Ben T: sim command we used:
```bash
python tools/sim_routing.py --trace traces/mix5k.json --policy "len>1800->int8;else->int6" --metrics cost,qa_acc,halluc_rate,p95 --out reports/atlas10b_lenhyb_4204204200.json
```

Miroslav: ops asks: add billing tag per-variant, expose per-slice halluc metric, and implement auto-fallback alarm.

Zara L: action items: I'll upload per-slice CSV + top-50 failures. Ben -> smoke harness for canary metrics. Ops -> billing tags + fallback alert. Product-GTN -> confirm canary cadence.

eval-bot: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-eval/atlas10b/4204204200/ (per-slice CSV, sim report, top failures)

Product-GTN: acknowledged. will review wording and confirm canary.

Zara L: end."
